item.title: Montgomery Multiplication: Theory Vs Realtity
item.description: Recently, in a blog post Yuval Domb describes a subtle, but remarkably clever optimisation that allows us to compute the montgomery product of two $n$ word1 integers using $2n^2 + 1$ multiplication operations. Although an improvement in theory, when compared with exisitng code for Montgomery multiplication, we were unable to manifest this speedup using the provided code. This post is a deep dive into why this could be? Before diving into the code, we give a brief overview of Montgomery Multiplication. We do not go into the proofs, but provide references to resources that go through the maths.
